title: Kvarðinn deployment diagram
description: How Kvarðinn runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and a Durable Object per room, behind icelander.net's sign-in for holders of the invite-only role games:kvardinn. No database. The same Worker deploys to icelander.net/games/fresh/kvardinn* by default, or, open to anyone, to the root of a workers.dev address with --env standalone.

nodes.name: Player's phone or laptop
nodes.description: Runs the page; one seat per device, remembered in that browser's localStorage.

nodes.name: Big screen (TV or projector)
nodes.description: The page at #CODE/skjar, opened by the players on a shared display: holds no seat and sees what a non-clue-giver sees.
nodes.condition: Only when the players open it

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/fresh/kvardinn* (BASE /games/fresh/kvardinn), deployed from main like the other games; or, with --env standalone, on a workers.dev address at the root (BASE empty), on whichever account wrangler is logged in to.

nodes.name: kvardinn Worker
nodes.description: worker/handler.ts, run before the assets for every request: on icelander.net it first checks the sign-in and the games:kvardinn role, then answers POST {BASE}/api/rooms, the WebSocket {BASE}/ws/CODE, and every other GET from ./dist under BASE.

nodes.name: Room Durable Object
nodes.description: One per four-letter code (binding ROOMS, SQLite-backed class Room): holds the game in its storage and every device's hibernatable WebSocket; an alarm deletes it after two idle days.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository: who holds the site_session cookie and whether they hold games:kvardinn, asked on every request. Reached only through the ACCOUNTS service binding; the standalone environment has none.

artifacts.name: app.js
artifacts.description: esbuild bundle of src/client/main.ts, minified; served as a static asset and run in the browser.

artifacts.name: index.html, style.css, icon.svg
artifacts.description: Copied from public/ into dist/ by build.mjs.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler and the Room class, bundled by wrangler with the rules and data/kvardar.txt.

relationships.description: Routes icelander.net/games/fresh/kvardinn* (or the workers.dev address) to the Worker.
Durable Object namespace ROOMS, migration rooms-v1.
HTTPS: the page and its files, and POST api/rooms; then a WebSocket to ws/CODE.
HTTPS for the page, then a WebSocket to ws/CODE marked as a screen.
idFromName(code): POST /init to create a room, and the WebSocket upgrade passed through.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the page, room creation and the room WebSockets need a signed-in player with games:kvardinn.
